svg.aria-label: I build systems that have to work where nobody is around to fix them: clinical decision support for rural hospitals in Tamil Nadu, a SLAM stack that corrects its own drift on a Jetson, and a post-quantum ledger for railway signalling. Right now I spend my days on observability and automation at DHL GSC and my evenings on deep learning for biomedical signals with IEEE EMBS at IIT Kharagpur.
